name: Aloracetam
summary: Aloracetam (INN) is a drug described as a nootropic which is closely related to, but technically not of (as it lacks a pyrrolidone ring), the racetam family of compounds. It was studied by Aventis for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease, but was never marketed.

uses.text: It was studied by Aventis for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease, but was never marketed.

fact.en: Although it is grouped with the racetams, it lacks their defining pyrrolidone ring, so strictly speaking it is not one.
fact.zh: 雖然它常被歸入 racetam 類，但它缺少這類藥物最具代表性的吡咯烷酮環，所以嚴格來說並不算是 racetam。
fact.zhHans: 虽然它常被归入 racetam 类，但它缺少这类药物最具代表性的吡咯烷酮环，所以严格来说并不算是 racetam。
